test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error.

She was desperate to find her lost cat and searched the __neverhood__ for hours.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"neverhood"** does not exist in English and appears to be a misspelling or typo. (गलत शब्द)

 
 
• **Example: **She was desperate to find her lost cat and searched the neverhood for hours. (Incorrect sentence)
 
 
 
• **"neighbourhood" **refers to a district or community within a town or city. (पड़ोस)
 
 
• **Example: **She was desperate to find her lost cat and searched the **neighbourhood** for hours.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **neighbourhood**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **neighborhood **(पड़ोस): This is the American spelling of** "neighbourhood"**.

 
 
• **Example:** The kids in the neighborhood love to play in the park.
 
 
 
• **neiverhood **(गलत शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not exist in English.
 
 
• **Example: **This word does not have a valid example as it is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **naighburhood** (गलत शब्द): This is another incorrect spelling and does not exist in English.
 
 
• **Example: **This word does not have a valid example as it is incorrect.
